key_insight: LLM-generated quantum circuits need layered validation because failures can be structurally plausible yet physically or operationally invalid.
engineering_relevance: For quantum software pipelines, gatekeeper checks and consistency metrics can prevent costly downstream errors in VQE circuit generation and similar workflow automation.
method: Screen outputs with seven physical/framework gatekeeper criteria.
Compare generated H2/STO-3G/Jordan-Wigner/UCCSD circuits against analytical and reference implementations.
Measure design entropy to assess run-to-run consistency and classify failure modes.
evidence_signal: Across multiple foundation models, the framework identified five distinct failure modes and also traced two apparent model errors to silent fallback behavior in the evaluation harness.
watch_item: Evaluation infrastructure itself must be treated as part of the trust boundary, since harness bugs can mimic model failures and distort conclusions.
paper_title: Gatekeepers and Hallucinations: A Layered Evaluation Framework for LLM-Driven Quantum Circuit Generation
